title: SNAP work requirements - federal basics
facts: SNAP has general work requirements for certain participants and separate time-limit/work rules for some adults unless an exemption applies.

Federal SNAP work rules have changed through legislation and implementation updates, so age ranges and exemptions must be checked against current USDA guidance before giving a specific eligibility conclusion.
States administer compliance and may have approved waivers in qualifying areas.
A person should not be told they are ineligible solely from a generic work-rule summary without checking exemptions and current state administration.
